clue.text: Girl, doubly popular, is to take part

parts.note: Jo is a short girl's name

indicators.note: doubly says the word for popular is to be written twice over

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

explanation.surface: A girl who is liked twice over decides to join the activity.
explanation.definitionFit: To participate in something is to enter alongside the others.

clue.text: Good condition of open country with money invested

indicators.note: money invested is money put inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a heath is open uncultivated land
L, from the Latin libra, is the abbreviation for pounds sterling

explanation.surface: A healthy state of affairs comes from moorland with cash sunk into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in good shape physically is the same as being well, a synonym.

clue.text: Yours truly using angry expression to dog

parts.note: cross means annoyed or angry
a word is an expression or term
a setter is a breed of gun dog

explanation.surface: Someone signs off a letter after shouting at the dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yours truly' is a letter's sign-off, but here it means the person writing these clues: the compiler speaking of themself.
explanation.definitionFit: The puzzle compiler refers to themself in a clue as 'yours truly', meaning 'me'.

clue.text: No women suffer this invisible phase

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are made to suffer, knocked into a new order

explanation.surface: Without women around, this invisible stage is endured.
explanation.definitionFit: At the start of the lunar cycle the moon's lit side faces away from Earth, so it cannot be seen.

clue.text: How deceptively one may be led to the back gate?

definitions.text: How deceptively one may be led to the back gate?

parts.words: How deceptively one may be led to the back gate?
parts.note: literally a walk through a garden to its rear gate; idiomatically, to be misled or deceived

explanation.surface: Someone is walked through the grounds to the rear exit under false pretences.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom of being led along a garden path means being tricked or deceived.

clue.text: Old tribesman sure to be thrown out of films

parts.note: the Picts were an ancient people of northern Scotland

indicators.note: the word sure is thrown out of shape, its letters jumbled

explanation.surface: An ancient warrior is certain to be ejected from the cinema.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be thrown out' rearranges SURE into URES.
explanation.definitionFit: The pictures is an informal British name for the cinema or movies.

clue.text: Second-rate ride, come off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters have gone bad or been knocked astray, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A disappointing trip on a horse ends with the rider falling.
explanation.definitionFit: Something of middling or poor quality is ordinary at best, a synonym.

clue.text: Happen to give the heavenly visitor a herb

parts.note: a comet visits the inner solar system periodically
rue is a bitter aromatic herb

explanation.surface: A comet arrives bearing a gift of herbs.
explanation.definitionFit: A wish or prediction that comes to pass is fulfilled, the same idea as happening.

clue.text: Elementary book used by painter

definitions.meaning: a beginner's textbook for learning to read or a subject
a preparatory undercoat applied before the paint

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a basic schoolbook and the first coat a decorator puts on.

clue.text: Feeble in the rain

definitions.meaning: British slang for weak or ineffectual
soaked, as one is after being out in rain

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both spineless and soaked with water.

clue.text: Male relatives with a million? That's America!

parts.note: uncles are male relatives

explanation.surface: Some uncles strike it rich, and that is the American dream.
explanation.definitionFit: The figure in a top hat is the traditional personification of the United States.

clue.text: Boasting of giving the latest impression

parts.note: hot news is the very latest
an air is an appearance or impression one gives off

explanation.surface: Someone brags while trying to seem up to date.
explanation.definitionFit: Empty talk or bragging is idiomatically called a lot of wind.

clue.text: Train about to crash? No nearer the answer

definitions.meaning: literally, a locomotive running on rails it should not be on
idiomatically, following a mistaken line of thought

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is literal for a misrouted train and idiomatic for someone reasoning mistakenly.

clue.text: Lie in sun, at about noon

indicators.note: about means the little word at is turned round

parts.note: N is short for noon, as in the compass-style abbreviation for twelve o'clock

explanation.surface: Someone sunbathes at around midday.
explanation.definitionFit: Lying in sunshine to brown the skin is to bronze oneself.

clue.text: Flourish given cooler diet

parts.note: a fan cools the air
fare is food, what one eats

explanation.surface: A grand gesture comes with a cooling drink and a plate of food.
explanation.definitionFit: A flourish of trumpets is a ceremonial musical announcement, the same thing.

clue.text: A year's rent for cattle?

parts.note: YR is the abbreviation for year, with the S of the possessive
to hire is to rent

explanation.surface: A farmer pays a year's rent for the herd.
explanation.definitionFit: This Scottish dairy breed is named for a county in south-west Scotland; the question mark marks a definition by example.

clue.text: He gets in the last round

definitions.text: He gets in the last round

parts.words: He gets in the last round
parts.note: sounds like a pub drinker getting the final drinks, but means a competitor reaching the closing stage

explanation.surface: A man buys the drinks at closing time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last round' suggests the pub's final orders; it is the deciding stage of a competition.
explanation.definitionFit: A competitor who reaches the deciding match of a tournament has qualified for it.

clue.text: Rather brittle part of fridge

definitions.meaning: a drawer at the bottom of a refrigerator for vegetables

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the comparative of crunchy and the name of the vegetable drawer.

clue.text: Philip ignoring insolence in foreign letter

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out the word for insolence from the name

parts.note: lip is slang for cheek or insolence

explanation.surface: Philip takes no notice of the rudeness in a letter from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The twenty-first letter of the Greek alphabet is a letter of a foreign script.

clue.text: Analyse girl's party

parts.note: Di is a short girl's name, with the S of the possessive
a sect is a faction or party

explanation.surface: Someone examines the details of a girl's celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: To cut something apart for close study is to examine it in detail.

clue.text: Regularly has too much! Not water surely?

definitions.text: Regularly has too much! Not water surely?

parts.words: Regularly has too much! Not water surely?
parts.note: describes a heavy drinker, with the joke that a creature living in water swallows it constantly

explanation.surface: Someone habitually overindulges, and it is not in water.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom compares a heavy drinker to a gill-breathing creature taking in water all day.

clue.text: Definitely one marine involved in flutter

indicators.note: involved in means one piece is wrapped inside the other

parts.note: to fly is to flit or flutter
I is the Roman numeral one
RM stands for Royal Marines

explanation.surface: A marine is certainly caught up in a little gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flutter' looks like a small bet; here it is the verb to flit.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something resolutely means saying it with certainty.

clue.text: Partner to get drunk around start of party

indicators.note: around says the drinking word goes round the other letter

parts.note: to souse is to steep, and soused means drunk

indicators.note: start of picks the opening letter of party

explanation.surface: A spouse gets plastered right from the beginning of the party.
explanation.definitionFit: A husband or wife is a marriage partner.

clue.text: Talk about the French house

indicators.note: about here means going round, so the word for talk surrounds the article

parts.note: chat means talk
le is the French masculine form of 'the'

explanation.surface: People talk about the French country home.
explanation.definitionFit: A Swiss-style wooden cottage is a type of house.

clue.text: Lake made better

definitions.meaning: the largest of North America's Great Lakes

explanation.definitionFit: The word names one of the Great Lakes and means higher in rank or quality.

clue.text: Digit used to point

definitions.meaning: dancers and footballers point the foot with this part

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a foot digit and the part one points with in ballet.

clue.text: Castaway's uncertain course

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is': the castaway is the answer

indicators.note: uncertain means the word course has an unsettled order of letters

explanation.surface: A shipwrecked sailor has no idea which way to steer.
explanation.definitionFit: Defoe's novel follows a sailor stranded alone on an island, the archetypal marooned man.

clue.text: Crystal's refined accent

definitions.meaning: the 's stands for 'is': fine glass with cut decoration
a precise upper-class English way of speaking

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names decorated glassware and, figuratively, a sharply posh British voice.
